_comment: UCSC catalog and regional response shapes captured from api.genome.ucsc.edu on 2026-08-16 and 2026-08-17. Whole-track responses are deterministic aggregations of those captured records for the source-wide cache contract. hg38 and ce11 expose CpG Islands; sacCer3 deliberately does not and instead exposes assembly-specific native interval tracks. sacCer3 also carries a trimmed sgdGene genePred track: UCSC serves gene models from its own tables rather than as files, and the exon structure proves a native table keeps the meaning the catalog declared.

cpgIslandExt.longLabel: CpG Islands (Islands < 300 Bases are Light Green)

crisprRanges.longLabel: Genome regions processed to find CRISPR/Cas9 target sites (exons +/- 200 bp)
